comment: Flagged-reason cases. Each case is a linear history (every event sees all earlier ones) on the genesis below; every step but the last must apply, and the last is flagged with the expected reason. gen-golden.js runs each case through the reference engine and fails when its reason differs; goOnly cases are skipped there.

cases.name: origin unknown
cases.reason: origin must be human, agent or agent-auto

cases.name: agent-auto accept
cases.reason: an agent never accepts, declines, returns or hands off an assignment on its own (agent-auto is invalid here)

cases.name: agent-auto comment
cases.reason: agent-auto is limited to item.status and item.close on the author's own assignment

cases.name: create without title
cases.reason: title required

cases.name: create bad kind
cases.reason: kind must be task, todo or topic

cases.name: edit empty title
cases.reason: title cannot be empty

cases.name: project not a string
cases.reason: project is one optional free-text string

cases.name: due not a date
cases.reason: due is an optional YYYY-MM-DD date

cases.name: priority out of range
cases.reason: priority must be a level 0..2 (알림 / 업무 / 긴급)

cases.name: parent unknown
cases.reason: parent zed.pc-9 is not in the state its author had seen

cases.name: parent hidden
cases.reason: parent ada.pc-3 is hidden

cases.name: parent not assigned
cases.reason: parent ada.pc-1 is neither assigned to nor created by omar

cases.name: item unknown
cases.reason: item zed.pc-1 is not in the state its author had seen

cases.name: edit by non-creator
cases.reason: only the creator (ada) edits ada.pc-1

cases.name: edit hidden
cases.reason: ada.pc-3 is hidden

cases.name: edit nothing
cases.reason: nothing to edit (title, body, project, due, priority)

cases.name: edit clears priority
cases.reason: priority cannot be cleared; set a level

cases.name: hide by non-creator
cases.reason: only the creator (ada) hides ada.pc-1

cases.name: hide twice
cases.reason: ada.pc-3 is already hidden

cases.name: hide with open assignment
cases.reason: unassign the open assignments first (maya)

cases.name: assign hidden
cases.reason: ada.pc-4 is hidden

cases.name: assign topic
cases.reason: topics have no assignment

cases.name: assign by non-creator
cases.reason: only the creator (ada) assigns ada.pc-1; an assignee hands off their own assignment with item.handoff

cases.name: assign bad completion
cases.reason: completion must be assignee or assigner

cases.name: assign all levels 0
cases.reason: levels must be >= 1

cases.name: assign all nobody below
cases.reason: nobody is within 1 levels below lena

cases.name: assign all covered
cases.reason: already assigned to everyone within 2 levels (ada.pc-4)

cases.name: assign nobody chosen
cases.reason: choose at least one person

cases.name: assign non-member
cases.reason: zed is not a member

cases.name: assign all chosen held
cases.reason: everyone chosen already holds a live or pending assignment

cases.name: assign bad mode
cases.reason: mode must be all or chosen

cases.name: handoff of someone else's
cases.reason: only the assignee (lena) hands off their assignment; an admin may hand off any member's

cases.name: status before accepting
cases.reason: lena has not accepted the pending assignment on sven.pc-1

cases.name: status after unassign
cases.reason: lena's assignment on maya.pc-1 ended (unassigned, maya.pc-3)

cases.name: status by unassigned creator
cases.reason: omar created omar.pc-1 but is not assigned to it (self-assign first)

cases.name: status by non-assignee
cases.reason: omar is not an assignee of maya.pc-1

cases.name: handoff done
cases.reason: assignment is done; nothing to hand off

cases.name: handoff without to
cases.reason: to required

cases.name: handoff to self
cases.reason: hand off to someone else

cases.name: handoff to unknown
cases.reason: unknown member "zed"

cases.name: handoff to removed
cases.reason: omar was removed (ada.pc-4)

cases.name: handoff to a holder
cases.reason: omar already holds a live or pending assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: handoff while one is pending
cases.reason: a handoff of this assignment to raj is already pending (lena.pc-2)

cases.name: accept a live one
cases.reason: lena's assignment on maya.pc-1 is already live

cases.name: accept without pending
cases.reason: omar has no pending assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: decline without pending
cases.reason: omar has no pending assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: accept a handoff whose original ended (295)
cases.reason: raj has no pending assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: return without live
cases.reason: omar has no live assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: return by non-lead
cases.reason: only lena's direct lead (maya) returns an accepted assignment

cases.name: return of a root's
cases.reason: only ada's direct lead (none: ada is a root) returns an accepted assignment

cases.name: return of a forced one
cases.reason: lena's assignment was forced by maya (their lead chain); only an accepted one is returnable

cases.name: unassign without assignment
cases.reason: omar has no live or pending assignment on maya.pc-1

cases.name: unassign by non-assigner
cases.reason: only the assigner (maya) unassigns

cases.name: withdraw by non-sender
cases.reason: only the assigner (maya) unassigns (or lena withdraws)

cases.name: withdraw all with nothing
cases.reason: omar has no assignments to withdraw on maya.pc-1

cases.name: status done
cases.reason: status must be todo, doing or blocked (done goes through item.close)

cases.name: status on done
cases.reason: assignment is done; reopen it first

cases.name: close twice
cases.reason: assignment is already done

cases.name: close while awaiting
cases.reason: already awaiting confirmation by ada

cases.name: confirm without live
cases.reason: no live assignment of ada.pc-1 to raj

cases.name: confirm by non-assigner
cases.reason: only the assigner (ada) confirms

cases.name: reject by non-assigner
cases.reason: only the assigner (ada) rejects

cases.name: confirm not required
cases.reason: this assignment does not require confirmation

cases.name: confirm not awaiting
cases.reason: assignment is todo, not awaiting confirmation

cases.name: reopen by a third member
cases.reason: only the assigner (maya) or the assignee (lena) reopens

cases.name: reopen not done
cases.reason: assignment is todo, not done

cases.name: reopen by non-assignee
cases.reason: omar is not an assignee of maya.pc-1

cases.name: comment on hidden thread
cases.reason: thread ada.pc-3 is hidden

cases.name: comment without body
cases.reason: body required

cases.name: reply to unknown
cases.reason: reply_to zed.pc-1 is not a comment its author had seen

cases.name: reply across threads
cases.reason: reply_to must be in the same thread

cases.name: reply to hidden
cases.reason: cannot reply to a hidden comment

cases.name: comment unknown
cases.reason: comment zed.pc-1 is not in the state its author had seen

cases.name: comment edit by other
cases.reason: only the comment author (lena) edits it

cases.name: comment hide by other
cases.reason: only the comment author (lena) hides it

cases.name: comment hidden twice
cases.reason: comment is already hidden

cases.name: comment edit without body
cases.reason: body required

cases.name: set_lead by non-admin
cases.reason: roles events are admin-only (maya is not an admin)

cases.name: set_priority_levels by non-admin
cases.reason: roles events are admin-only (maya is not an admin)

cases.name: set_lead unknown member
cases.reason: unknown member "zed"

cases.name: set_lead leads not a list
cases.reason: leads must be a list

cases.name: set_lead two leads
cases.reason: leads must have length at most 1 (got 2)

cases.name: set_lead unknown lead
cases.reason: lead "zed" is not a member

cases.name: set_lead cycle
cases.reason: cycle: lena is already below ada

cases.name: priority levels empty
cases.reason: names must be a non-empty list (lowest to highest)

cases.name: priority levels too many
cases.reason: at most 9 priority levels

cases.name: priority level blank
cases.reason: every level needs a display name

cases.name: priority default out of range
cases.reason: default must be a level 0..1

cases.name: mentions not a list
cases.reason: mentions must be a list of member ids

cases.name: mention non-string
cases.reason: mentions must be a list of member ids

cases.name: mention unknown
cases.reason: mentioned "zed" is not a member

cases.name: mention removed
cases.reason: mentioned omar was removed (ada.pc-4)

cases.name: mention on comment edit
cases.reason: mentioned "zed" is not a member

cases.name: mentions without body edit
cases.reason: mentions and attachments go with a body edit

cases.name: attachments not a list
cases.reason: attachments must be a list of {oid, name, size, mime}

cases.name: attachment oid not sha256
cases.reason: attachment oid must be the sha256 of the content (64 lowercase hex digits)

cases.name: attachment name missing
cases.reason: attachment name required

cases.name: attachment size fractional
cases.reason: attachment size must be a byte count

cases.name: attachment mime missing
cases.reason: attachment mime type required

cases.name: attachment over limit
cases.reason: attachment "big.bin" is 10485761 bytes, above the store limit of 10485760 bytes (attachments.max_bytes)

cases.name: attachment over a lowered limit
cases.reason: attachment "b.png" is 101 bytes, above the store limit of 100 bytes (attachments.max_bytes)

cases.name: set_attachment_limit by non-admin
cases.reason: roles events are admin-only (maya is not an admin)

cases.name: attachment limit not positive
cases.reason: max_bytes must be a positive integer (bytes)

cases.name: attachment limit fractional
cases.reason: max_bytes must be a positive integer (bytes)

cases.name: unknown type
cases.reason: unknown event type "item.frobnicate"

cases.name: add_member stand-in is unknown
cases.reason: unknown event type "roles.add_member"
